check_input_dir = function(dir, input_name) {
  if (!is.null(dir) && !fs::dir_exists(dir)) {
    stop(
      glue::glue("{input_name} does not exist: {dir}"),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

  length(TEST_DOMAINS) == 0 ||
  is.null(names(TEST_DOMAINS)) ||
  anyNA(names(TEST_DOMAINS)) ||
  any(!nzchar(names(TEST_DOMAINS))) ||
  anyDuplicated(names(TEST_DOMAINS)) ||

```{r select_wrf_files, include=F}
wrf_run_settings = NULL

if (isTRUE(PRINT_WRF_SETTINGS)) {

  if (!fs::dir_exists(TEST_DIR)) {
    warning(
      glue::glue(
        "Cannot print WRF settings because TEST_DIR is inaccessible: {TEST_DIR}"
      )
    )
  } else {

    wrf_files = fs::dir_ls(TEST_DIR) %>%
      stringr::str_subset(
        stringr::str_c('wrfout_', tail(TEST_DOMAINS, 1), '_')
      ) %>%
      sort()

    if (length(wrf_files) == 0) {
      warning('No WRF output files found for the innermost Test domain.')
    } else {

      first_file = wrf_files[[1]]
      last_file = wrf_files[[length(wrf_files)]]

      first_time = read_wrf_times(first_file)[[1]]
      last_time = read_wrf_times(last_file) %>% tail(1)

      wrf_run_settings = summarise_wrf_run_settings(
        first_file = first_file,
        last_file = last_file
      )
    }
  }
}

```{r}
# RUN INFORMATION ----------------------------------------------------------

ref_submitted = !is.null(REF_DIR)
ref_qaqc_submitted = !is.null(REF_QAQC_DIR)

# Extract the simulation period from the original WRF files, if available.

get_wrf_run_period = function(wrf_dir, domain) {

  if (is.null(wrf_dir)) {
    return(c(start = 'Not submitted', end = 'Not submitted'))
  }

  if (!fs::dir_exists(wrf_dir)) {
    return(c(start = 'Not accessible', end = 'Not accessible'))
  }

  wrf_files = fs::dir_ls(
    wrf_dir,
    regexp = paste0('wrfout_', domain, '_')
  ) %>%
    sort()

  if (length(wrf_files) == 0) {
    return(c(start = 'No WRF files', end = 'No WRF files'))
  }

  first_time = read_wrf_times(wrf_files[[1]])[[1]]
  last_time = read_wrf_times(tail(wrf_files, 1)[[1]]) %>%
    tail(1)

  c(
    start = format(first_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'),
    end = format(last_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
  )
}

# Use the first submitted domain to determine the simulation period.

run_domain = unname(TEST_DOMAINS[[1]])

test_period = get_wrf_run_period(TEST_DIR, run_domain)
ref_period = get_wrf_run_period(REF_DIR, run_domain)

# Prepare domain information.

domain_parameters = paste(names(TEST_DOMAINS), 'domain')

test_domain_names = unname(TEST_DOMAINS)

ref_domain_names = if (is.null(REF_DIR)) {
  rep('Not submitted', length(TEST_DOMAINS))
} else {
  unname(TEST_DOMAINS)
}

test_period = get_wrf_run_period(TEST_DIR, run_domain)
ref_period = get_wrf_run_period(REF_DIR, run_domain)

# Run Info table.

run_info_table = tibble::tibble(
  Parameter = c(
    'WRF run directory',
    'QAQC data directory',
    domain_parameters,
    'Start time',
    'End time'
  ),
  test = c(
    if (is.null(TEST_DIR)) 'Not submitted' else TEST_DIR,
    qaqc_pth_out,
    test_domain_names,
    test_period[['start']],
    test_period[['end']]
  ),
  ref = c(
    if (ref_submitted) REF_DIR else 'Not submitted',
    if (ref_qaqc_submitted) REF_QAQC_DIR else 'Not submitted',
    ref_domain_names,
    ref_period[['start']],
    ref_period[['end']]
  )
)
```

# Run Info

```{r}

# Determine the temporal overlap between Test and Reference runs.

testref_start_date = NULL
testref_end_date = NULL
testref_period_overlap = FALSE

if (
  !is.null(REF_DIR) &&
  !is.na(as.POSIXct(test_period['start'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC')) &&
  !is.na(as.POSIXct(ref_period['start'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC'))
) {

  testref_start_date = max(
    as.POSIXct(test_period['start'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC'),
    as.POSIXct(ref_period['start'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC')
  )

  testref_end_date = min(
    as.POSIXct(test_period['end'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC'),
    as.POSIXct(ref_period['end'], format = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', tz = 'UTC')
  )

  testref_period_overlap = testref_start_date < testref_end_date

  if (!testref_period_overlap) {
    testref_start_date = NULL
    testref_end_date = NULL
  }
}

run_info_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(test, ref),
      ~ ifelse(
        Parameter %in% c('WRF run directory', 'QAQC data directory'),
        stringr::str_replace_all(.x, '/', '/<wbr>'),
        .x
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(test, ref),
    rows = Parameter %in% c('WRF run directory', 'QAQC data directory')
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    test = RUN_LABELS[[1]],
    ref = RUN_LABELS[[2]]
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_width(
    Parameter ~ gt::px(140),
    test ~ gt::px(320),
    ref ~ gt::px(320)
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::css(
      `white-space` = 'normal',
      `overflow-wrap` = 'normal',
      `word-break` = 'normal'
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_body(
      columns = c(test, ref),
      rows = Parameter %in% c('WRF run directory', 'QAQC data directory')
    )
  )

```{r variable-lookup-table, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

lookup_vars = unique(c(

)) %>%
  purrr::discard(~ is.na(.x) || .x == 'all') %>%

    var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST

  Unit = purrr::map_chr(

```{r create-summary-map-data, eval = make_summary_maps, include=FALSE}

task_start = Sys.time()

summary_map_data = NULL
summary_map_plots = NULL
summary_map_grobs = NULL
summary_map_leaflet = NULL
summary_map_vars_report = NULL
report_map_height = NULL

if (isTRUE(make_summary_maps)) {

  # Prepare optional spatial filters.

  domain_crop_sf = as_domain_polygon_sf(
    SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_CROP,
    filter_name = 'domain crop'
  )

  domain_mask_sf = as_domain_polygon_sf(
    SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_MASK,
    filter_name = 'domain mask'
  )

  # Identify available Test summary variables for each requested domain,
  # accounting for the requested statistic and date tag.

  if (!fs::dir_exists(TEST_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR)) {
    stop(glue::glue(
      "Test WRF summary directory does not exist: {TEST_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR}"
    ))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR) &&
    !fs::dir_exists(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR)) {
    stop(glue::glue(
      "Reference WRF summary directory does not exist: {REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR}"
    ))
  }
  
  test_summary_files = fs::dir_ls(
    TEST_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR,
    regexp = '\\.nc$'
  )

  available_test_vars = TEST_DOMAINS %>%
    purrr::set_names(names(TEST_DOMAINS)) %>%
    purrr::map(function(domain) {

      file_names = fs::path_file(test_summary_files)

      file_info = stringr::str_match(
        file_names,
        paste0(
          '^', domain,
          '_(.+?)_(mean|median|min|max|sd|sum|accum)_(.+)\\.nc$'
        )
      )

      available = tibble::tibble(
        variable = file_info[, 2],
        stat = file_info[, 3],
        date_tag = file_info[, 4]
      ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(variable)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          (variable == 'precip' & stat == 'accum') |
            (variable != 'precip' & stat == SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT)
        )

      if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_DATE_TAG)) {
        available = available %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            stringr::str_detect(
              date_tag,
              stringr::fixed(SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_DATE_TAG)
            )
          )
      }

      unique(available$variable)
    })
  
  # Resolve requested variables.

  if (identical(SUMMARY_MAP_VARS, 'all')) {
  
    summary_map_vars = available_test_vars %>%
      unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
      unique()
  
  } else {
  
    summary_map_vars = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS
  
  }
  
  if (length(summary_map_vars) == 0) {
    stop(
      'No Test summary-map variables are available for plotting.',
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (!identical(SUMMARY_MAP_VARS, 'all')) {

    missing_test_vars = available_test_vars %>%
      purrr::imap(function(vars, domain_name) {
        missing = setdiff(summary_map_vars, vars)
  
        if (length(missing) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }
  
        tibble::tibble(
          domain = domain_name,
          variable = missing
        )
      }) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows()
  
    if (nrow(missing_test_vars) > 0) {
      stop(
        'Missing Test summaries for explicitly requested variables:\n',
        paste(
          paste0(
            missing_test_vars$domain,
            ': ',
            missing_test_vars$variable
          ),
          collapse = '\n'
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
  }
  
  # Resolve the subset displayed in the HTML report.

  summary_map_vars_report = resolve_selection(
    selection = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT,
    available = summary_map_vars,
    input_name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT'
  )

  # Build Test / Reference / difference data for every requested variable
  # and domain.

  summary_map_data = summary_map_vars %>%
    purrr::set_names() %>%
    purrr::map(function(v) {

      domain_data = TEST_DOMAINS %>%
        purrr::imap(function(domain, domain_name) {
          
          # Skip unavailable Test summaries when 'all' is requested.
          if (identical(SUMMARY_MAP_VARS, 'all') &&
              !v %in% available_test_vars[[domain_name]]) {
            return(NULL)
          }

          # Precipitation summaries use accumulated totals.

          test_stat = if (v == 'precip') {
            'accum'
          } else {
            SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT
          }

          ref_stat = if (v == 'precip') {
            'accum'
          } else {
            SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
          }

          # Select Test summary file.

          this_test_file = select_wrf_summary_file(
            summary_dir = TEST_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR,
            domain = domain,
            var = v,
            stat = test_stat,
            date_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_DATE_TAG
          )

          # Select Reference summary file, if available.

          this_ref_file = if (!is.null(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR)) {
            select_wrf_summary_file(
              summary_dir = REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR,
              domain = domain,
              var = v,
              stat = ref_stat,
              date_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_DATE_TAG
            )
          } else {
            NULL
          }

          this_ref_crs = if (exists('REF_CRS') && !is.null(REF_CRS)) {
            REF_CRS
          } else {
            TEST_CRS
          }

          # Calculate Test / Reference / difference data.

          this_diff = calculate_wrf_summary_diff_pair(
            wrf_var = v,
            test_fname = this_test_file,
            ref_fname = this_ref_file,
            test_crs = TEST_CRS,
            ref_crs = this_ref_crs,
            run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
            diff_direction = DIFF_DIRECTION
          )

          # Apply optional spatial filters.

          this_diff = apply_domain_filters_stars(
            x = this_diff,
            domain_crop = domain_crop_sf,
            domain_mask = domain_mask_sf
          )

          this_diff
        })

      # Remove relative differences where they are not meaningful.

      plot_reldiff = get_var_param(
        var = v,
        key = c('maps', 'plot_reldiff'),
        var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        default = TRUE
      )

      if (!isTRUE(plot_reldiff)) {
        domain_data = domain_data %>%
          purrr::map(function(this_diff) {
      
            if (is.null(this_diff)) {
              return(NULL)
            }
      
            this_diff$rel_diff = NULL
            this_diff
          })
      }

      domain_data
    })
}
```

```{r summary_maps_user_text, eval = make_summary_maps, results='asis'}

cat('\n# Summary Maps\n\n')

# Describe the summary statistics.

summary_map_test_stat_text = format_summary_stat_plural(
  SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT
)

summary_map_ref_stat_text = format_summary_stat_plural(
  SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
)

if (
  !is.null(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR) &&
  SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT != SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
) {

  summary_map_stat_text = paste(
    summary_map_test_stat_text,
    'for the Test run and',
    summary_map_ref_stat_text,
    'for the Reference run'
  )

} else {

  summary_map_stat_text = summary_map_test_stat_text

}

cat(
  paste(
    'Summary maps showing modelled',
    summary_map_stat_text,
    'have been generated for the selected variables.'
  )
)

cat('\n\n')

if ('precip' %in% summary_map_vars) {
  cat(
    'Precipitation maps show accumulated precipitation over the summary period.\n\n'
  )
}

# Describe optional spatial filtering.

if (
  !is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_CROP) ||
  !is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_MASK)
) {

  spatial_filter_text = character(0)

  if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_CROP)) {
    spatial_filter_text = c(
      spatial_filter_text,
      'cropped to the bounding box of the spatial data supplied in SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_CROP'
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_MASK)) {
    spatial_filter_text = c(
      spatial_filter_text,
      'masked to the polygon geometry supplied in SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_MASK'
    )
  }

  cat(
    paste0(
      'The displayed map data have been ',
      paste(spatial_filter_text, collapse = ' and '),
      '.'
    )
  )

  cat('\n\n')
}

# Describe Reference comparisons.

if (!is.null(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR)) {

  cat(
    paste(
      'Where corresponding Reference summaries are available,',
      'the maps also show the absolute and relative differences',
      'between the Test and Reference runs.'
    )
  )

  cat('\n\n')
}

# Describe interactive maps.

if (make_interactive_summary_maps) {

  cat(
    paste(
      'Interactive maps are projected from the original WRF',
      'coordinate system to EPSG:3857 using nearest-neighbour resampling.'
    )
  )

  cat('\n\n')
}

# List mapped variables.

cat(
  paste(

```{r create-static-summary-maps, include=FALSE, eval=make_static_summary_maps}

# Format summary statistics for map titles.

summary_map_test_stat_title = format_summary_stat(
  SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT
)

summary_map_ref_stat_title = format_summary_stat(
  SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
)

# Load geographical features.

map_geo_features = load_map_geo_features(MAPPING_GEO_LIST)

# Create static maps for each variable and domain.

summary_map_plots = summary_map_data %>%
  purrr::imap(function(this_var_diff, v) {

    this_var_diff %>%
      purrr::imap(function(domain_diff, domain) {

        if (is.null(domain_diff)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        has_ref = RUN_LABELS[[2]] %in% names(domain_diff)

        n_plot_cols = if (has_ref) 2 else 1

        this_cbar_width = get_summary_map_cbar_width(
          n_plot_cols = n_plot_cols,
          fig_width = knitr::opts_chunk$get('fig.width') %||% 8.4,
          cbar_width = CBAR_WIDTH
        )

        plot_obj = plot_summary_maps(
          diff_list = stats::setNames(list(domain_diff), domain),
          emep_var = v,
          var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          map_geo_params_list = map_geo_features,
          testref_pal_pth = TESTREF_PALETTE,
          absdiff_pal_pth = ABSDIFF_PALETTE,
          reldiff_pal_pth = RELDIFF_PALETTE,
          plot_titles = PLOT_TITLES,
          cbar_label_angle = CBAR_LABEL_ANGLE,
          cbar_label_vjust = CBAR_LABEL_VJUST,
          cbar_label_hjust = CBAR_LABEL_HJUST,
          cbar_width = this_cbar_width,
          cbar_height = CBAR_HEIGHT,
          legend_title_size = LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE,
          legend_text_size = LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE,
          rasterise_map_layers = SUMMARY_MAP_PDF_RASTERISE,
          raster_dpi = SUMMARY_MAP_PDF_DPI
        )

        attr(plot_obj, 'map_stars') = domain_diff[[RUN_LABELS[[1]]]]
        attr(plot_obj, 'map_data') = domain_diff
        attr(plot_obj, 'domain') = domain

        plot_obj
      })
  })

summary_map_plots = summary_map_plots %>%
  purrr::map(purrr::compact)

# Arrange map panels.

summary_map_grobs = summary_map_plots %>%
  purrr::map(function(var_plots) {

    var_plots %>%
      purrr::map(arrange_comp_map_output) %>%
      purrr::map(
        add_grob_outer_margin,
        left = 0.25,
        right = 0.25,
        top = 0.05,
        bottom = 0.10
      )
  })

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare standalone PDF output
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {

  # Determine whether all domains for each variable contain Test-only maps.

  test_only_maps = summary_map_plots %>%
    purrr::map_lgl(function(var_plots) {

      all(
        purrr::map_int(
          var_plots,
          ~ length(.x$plots)
        ) == 1
      )
    })
  
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create PDF map pages
    #
    # Each variable/domain combination is stored as a separate page.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  
    summary_map_pdf_pages = summary_map_grobs %>%
      .[sort(names(.))] %>%
      purrr::imap(function(var_grobs, v) {
  
        purrr::imap(
          var_grobs,
          function(domain_grob, domain) {
  
            list(
              title = v,
              domain = domain,
              grob = domain_grob
            )
          }
        )
      }) %>%
      purrr::list_flatten()
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create paginated PDF contents pages.
    #
    # The front page and contents pages are unnumbered.
    # Map-page numbering starts at Page 1.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    summary_map_contents = summary_map_pdf_pages %>%
      unname() %>%
      purrr::imap_dfr(function(page, i) {
    
        tibble::tibble(
          var = page$title,
          page = i
        )
    
      }) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(var, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    
    contents_rows_per_page = 24
    
    contents_page_groups = split(
      summary_map_contents,
      ceiling(seq_len(nrow(summary_map_contents)) / contents_rows_per_page)
    )
    
    
    make_contents_page = function(contents_data, contents_page) {
    
      contents_title = grid::textGrob(
        if (contents_page == 1) 'Contents' else 'Contents (continued)',
        x = grid::unit(0.08, 'npc'),
        just = 'left',
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fontsize = 16,
          fontface = 'bold'
        )
      )
    
      contents_rows = contents_data %>%
        purrr::pmap(function(var, page) {
      
          var_lab = format_var_label(
            var = var,
            var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
            context = 'maps',
            output = 'plotmath',
            include_units = TRUE
          )
      
          var_lab = parse(text = var_lab)[[1]]
      
          var_grob = grid::textGrob(
            var_lab,
            x = grid::unit(0.08, 'npc'),
            just = 'left',
            gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)
          )
    
          page_grob = grid::textGrob(
            page,
            x = grid::unit(0.92, 'npc'),
            just = 'right',
            gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)
          )
    
          leader_grob = grid::segmentsGrob(
            x0 = grid::unit(0.08, 'npc') +
              grid::grobWidth(var_grob) +
              grid::unit(0.08, 'in'),
            x1 = grid::unit(0.92, 'npc') -
              grid::grobWidth(page_grob) -
              grid::unit(0.08, 'in'),
            y0 = grid::unit(0.4, 'npc'),
            y1 = grid::unit(0.4, 'npc'),
            gp = grid::gpar(
              lty = 'dotted',
              lwd = 1
            )
          )
    
          grid::grobTree(
            var_grob,
            leader_grob,
            page_grob
          )
        })
    
      contents_grob = gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
        grobs = c(contents_rows, list(grid::nullGrob())),
        ncol = 1,
        heights = grid::unit.c(
          grid::unit(rep(0.32, length(contents_rows)), 'in'),
          grid::unit(1, 'null')
        )
      )
    
      gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
        contents_title,
        contents_grob,
        ncol = 1,
        heights = c(0.08, 0.92)
      )
    }
    
    summary_map_contents_pages = contents_page_groups %>%
      purrr::imap(function(contents_data, contents_page) {
    
        make_contents_page(
          contents_data = contents_data,
          contents_page = contents_page
        )
    
      })
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Add map-page titles and page numbers.
    #
    # The front page and contents pages are unnumbered.
    # Map pages start at Page 1.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    summary_map_grobs_pdf = summary_map_pdf_pages %>%
      unname() %>%
      purrr::imap(function(page, i) {
    
        # Format variable label.
    
        var_lab = format_var_label(
          var = page$title,
          var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          context = 'maps',
          output = 'plotmath',
          include_units = TRUE
        )
    
        # Identify the summary statistic.
    
        this_stat = if (page$title == 'precip') {
          'Accumulated'
        } else {
          summary_map_test_stat_title
        }
    
        # Create page title.
    
        page_title = grid::textGrob(
          label = parse(text = stringr::str_glue(
            '"{this_stat}"~{var_lab}'
          ))[[1]],
          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = 'bold')
        )
    
        # Add domain name beneath the title.
    
        page_domain = grid::textGrob(
          page$domain,
          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
        )
    
        page_header = gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
          page_title,
          page_domain,
          ncol = 1,
          heights = c(0.6, 0.4)
        )
    
        # Add page number.
    
        page_number = grid::textGrob(
          stringr::str_glue('Page {i}'),
          x = grid::unit(0.96, 'npc'),
          just = 'right',
          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
        )
    
        # Assemble the complete PDF page.
    
        gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
          page_header,
          page$grob,
          page_number,
          ncol = 1,
          heights = c(0.055, 0.915, 0.03)
        )
      })
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create PDF front page
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    front_page_title = grid::textGrob(
      'WRF QAQC summary maps',
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.94,
      just = 'centre',
      gp = grid::gpar(
        fontsize = 18,
        fontface = 'bold'
      )
    )
    
    # Format domain information, preserving outer-to-inner order.
    
    domain_info = stringr::str_glue(
      '{names(TEST_DOMAINS)}: {TEST_DOMAINS}'
    ) %>%
      stringr::str_c(collapse = '\n')
    
    # Test run information.
    
    front_page_info = c(
      'Test run',
      wrap_file_path(QAQC_DIR)
    )
    
    if (!is.null(REF_QAQC_DIR)) {
    
      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference run',
        wrap_file_path(REF_QAQC_DIR)
      )
    }
    
    # Domain and summary information.
    
    front_page_info = c(
      front_page_info,
      '',
      stringr::str_glue('Domains:\n{domain_info}'),
      '',
      'Test statistic',
      SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT
    )
    
    if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_DATE_TAG)) {
    
      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Test date tag',
        SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_DATE_TAG
      )
    }
    
    if (!is.null(REF_WRF_SUMMARY_DIR)) {
    
      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference statistic',
        SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
      )
    
      if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_REF_DATE_TAG)) {
    
        front_page_info = c(
          front_page_info,
          '',
          'Reference date tag',
          SUMMARY_MAP_REF_DATE_TAG
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Create front-page information grob.
    
    front_page_info_grob = grid::textGrob(
      paste(front_page_info, collapse = '\n'),
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.86,
      just = c('centre', 'top'),
      gp = grid::gpar(
        fontsize = 11,
        lineheight = 1.35
      )
    )
    
    # Assemble front page.
    
    summary_map_front_page = grid::grobTree(
      front_page_title,
      front_page_info_grob
    )
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine suitable figure height for static maps shown in the HTML
    # report.
    #
    # Use the largest required height so that dynamically generated child
    # chunks can share one figure height.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    if (isTRUE(PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS)) {
    
      report_map_heights = summary_map_plots %>%
        purrr::map(function(var_plots) {
    
          var_plots %>%
            purrr::map_dbl(function(plot_obj) {
    
              get_comp_map_fig_height(
                map_stars = attr(plot_obj, 'map_stars'),
                n_plots = length(plot_obj$plots),
                fig_width = knitr::opts_chunk$get('fig.width') %||% 8.4
              )
            })
        }) %>%
        purrr::list_c()
    
      report_map_heights = report_map_heights[
        is.finite(report_map_heights) &
          !is.na(report_map_heights)
      ]
    
      if (length(report_map_heights) > 0) {
        report_map_height = max(report_map_heights)
      }
    }
}

```{r include-summary-maps, results='asis', eval=PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS || PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS, fig.width=8.4}
available_summary_map_vars = unique(
  c(
    names(summary_map_plots %||% list()),
    names(summary_map_leaflet %||% list())
  )
)

summary_map_vars_to_render = summary_map_vars_report[
  summary_map_vars_report %in% available_summary_map_vars
] %>%
  sort()

chunk_fence = stringr::str_c(
  '`',
  '`',
  '`'
)

make_safe_chunk_label = function(
    x,
    i
) {

  out = x %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+',
      '-'
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      '^-|-$',
      ''
    )

  if (is.na(out) || out == '') {

    out = stringr::str_glue(
      'var-{i}'
    )
  }

  out
}

report_map_height_safe = if (
  !is.null(report_map_height) &&
  length(report_map_height) == 1 &&
  is.finite(report_map_height) &&
  !is.na(report_map_height)
) {

  report_map_height

} else {

  6
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create variable sections
#
# Static report:
#
# ## Variable
# ### Domain
# [static map]
#
# Interactive report, one map type:
#
# ## Variable {.tabset}
# ### Domain
# [map]
#
# Interactive report, both map types:
#
# ## Variable {.tabset}
# ### Domain {.tabset}
# #### Static
# [static map]
# #### Interactive
# [interactive map]
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

summary_map_child = purrr::imap_chr(
  summary_map_vars_to_render,
  function(var_nm, i) {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine map types to display in the report
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    show_static =
      isTRUE(PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS) &&
      var_nm %in% names(summary_map_plots %||% list())
    
    show_interactive =
      isTRUE(make_interactive_summary_maps) &&
      var_nm %in% names(summary_map_leaflet %||% list())

    show_both =
      show_static &&
      show_interactive

    safe_var_nm = make_safe_chunk_label(
      var_nm,
      i
    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine domains available for this variable
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    static_domains = if (show_static) {

      names(
        summary_map_plots[[var_nm]]
      )

    } else {

      character()
    }

    interactive_domains = if (show_interactive) {

      names(
        summary_map_leaflet[[var_nm]]
      )

    } else {

      character()
    }

    domain_names = unique(
      c(
        static_domains,
        interactive_domains
      )
    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create domain sections
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    domain_chunks = purrr::imap_chr(
      domain_names,
      function(domain_id, domain_i) {

        domain_lab = names(TEST_DOMAINS)[
          match(domain_id, TEST_DOMAINS)
        ]
        
        if (length(domain_lab) == 0 || is.na(domain_lab)) {
          domain_lab = domain_id
        }

        safe_domain = make_safe_chunk_label(
          domain_id,
          domain_i
        )

        this_static =
          show_static &&
          domain_id %in% static_domains

        this_interactive =
          show_interactive &&
          domain_id %in% interactive_domains

        this_show_both =
          this_static &&
          this_interactive


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Static map
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        static_chunk = if (this_static) {

          static_heading = if (this_show_both) {
            '\n\n#### Static\n\n'
          } else {
            '\n\n'
          }

          stringr::str_c(
            static_heading,
            glue::glue(
              .open = '<<',
              .close = '>>',
                '<<chunk_fence>>{r summary-map-static-<<safe_var_nm>>-<<safe_domain>>, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8.4, fig.height=report_map_height_safe, dpi=SUMMARY_MAP_REPORT_DPI, fig.retina=1}
  
  print(
    arrange_comp_map_output(
      summary_map_plots[["<<var_nm>>"]][["<<domain_id>>"]]
    )
  )
  
  <<chunk_fence>>
  
  '
            )
          )

        } else {

          ''
        }


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Interactive map
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        interactive_chunk = if (this_interactive) {

          interactive_heading = if (this_show_both) {
            '\n\n#### Interactive\n\n'
          } else {
            '\n\n'
          }

          stringr::str_c(
            interactive_heading,
            glue::glue(
              .open = '<<',
              .close = '>>',
              '<<chunk_fence>>{r summary-map-interactive-<<safe_var_nm>>-<<safe_domain>>, echo=FALSE}

              domain_maps = summary_map_leaflet[["<<var_nm>>"]][["<<domain_id>>"]]
              
              htmltools::tagList(
                purrr::imap(
                  domain_maps,
                  function(this_map, map_type) {
              
                    plot_title = dplyr::case_when(
                      map_type == "test" ~ PLOT_TITLES[1],
                      map_type == "ref" ~ PLOT_TITLES[2],
                      map_type == "absdiff" ~ PLOT_TITLES[3],
                      map_type == "reldiff" ~ PLOT_TITLES[4],
                      TRUE ~ NA_character_
                    )
              
                    map_type_label = if (
                      !is.na(plot_title) &&
                      nzchar(plot_title)
                    ) {
              
                      plot_title
              
                    } else {
              
                      dplyr::case_when(
                        map_type == "test" ~ test_label,
                        map_type == "ref" ~ ref_label,
                        map_type == "absdiff" ~ "Absolute difference",
                        map_type == "reldiff" ~ "Relative difference",
                        TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_sentence(
                          stringr::str_replace_all(
                            map_type,
                            "_",
                            " "
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    }
              
                    htmltools::tagList(
                      if (length(domain_maps) > 1) {
              
                        htmltools::tags$h4(
                          map_type_label
                        )
                      },
                      this_map
                    )
                  }
                )
              )
              
              <<chunk_fence>>
              
              '
            )
          )

        } else {

          ''
        }


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Domain heading
        #
        # In an interactive report, domains are tabs because the variable
        # heading is a tabset. If both static and interactive maps are
        # present, the domain itself becomes a nested tabset.
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        domain_heading = paste0(
          '\n\n### ',
          domain_lab,
          if (
            REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' &&
            this_show_both
          ) {
            ' {.tabset}'
          } else {
            ''
          },
          '\n\n'
        )

        stringr::str_c(
          domain_heading,
          static_chunk,
          interactive_chunk
        )
      }
    ) %>%
      stringr::str_c(
        collapse = '\n'
      )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variable heading
    #
    # Interactive reports use the variable heading as the domain tabset.
    # Static reports retain ordinary headings so all domains are visible
    # sequentially.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    var_lab = format_var_label(
      var = var_nm,
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
      context = 'maps',
      output = 'html',
      include_units = TRUE
    )
    
    variable_heading = paste0(
      '\n\n## ',
      var_lab,
      if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
        ' {.tabset}'
      } else {
        ''
      },
      '\n\n'
    )

    stringr::str_c(
      variable_heading,
      domain_chunks
    )
  }
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Render Maps section
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = summary_map_child,
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ),
  sep = '\n'
)

if (identical(MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL, 'params_file')) {

# Apply the WRF domain filters.

sites_used_pth = find_sites_used_file(
  data_pth_out
)

if (is.null(sites_used_pth)) {
  stop(
    'Could not find Sites_used.rds or 00Sites_used.rds in: ',
    data_pth_out,
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

sites_geo = readr::read_rds(
  sites_used_pth
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    code,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  !MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(sites_geo)
) {

  logger::log_warn(
    glue::glue(
      "MOBS grouping variable '{MOBS_GROUPING_VAR}' is not available ",
      'in sites_geo. Site grouping will be disabled.'
    )
  )

  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR = NULL
}

sites_geo = apply_domain_filter_sites(
  sites_geo = sites_geo,
  domain_crop = NULL,
  domain_mask = mobs_domain_mask_sf
)

domain_site_codes = sites_geo %>%
  dplyr::pull(code) %>%
  unique() %>%
  stats::na.omit() %>%
  as.character()

if (length(domain_site_codes) == 0) {
  stop(
    'No monitoring sites remain after applying DOMAIN_CROP/DOMAIN_MASK.',
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Read saved MOBS data, restricted to retained sites.

mobs_pths_all = fs::dir_ls(
  data_pth_out,
  regexp = '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
)

mobs_pth_codes = mobs_pths_all %>%
  fs::path_file() %>%
  stringr::str_remove('_mod_obs\\.rds$')

mobs_pths = mobs_pths_all[
  mobs_pth_codes %in% domain_site_codes
]

missing_mobs_site_codes = setdiff(
  domain_site_codes,
  mobs_pth_codes
)

if (length(missing_mobs_site_codes) > 0) {

  logger::log_warn(
    stringr::str_glue(
      'No mod_obs.rds files found for retained site(s): {paste(missing_mobs_site_codes, collapse = ", ")}'
    )
  )
}

if (length(mobs_pths) == 0) {
  stop(
    'No mod_obs.rds files found for sites retained after applying DOMAIN_CROP/DOMAIN_MASK.',
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Load and convert MOBS data.

mobs_load_workers = set_parallel_plan(
  workers_requested = worker_cap,
  max_workers = 8,
  prefer_multicore = TRUE
)

# qaqc_parallel_info[['MOBS load']] = tibble::tibble(
#   section = 'MOBS load',
#   workers = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())
# )

mobs_list = mobs_pths %>%
  furrr::future_map(
    ~ readr::read_rds(.x) %>%
      mobs_to_long(),
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(
      seed = TRUE,
      scheduling = Inf,
      packages = c(
        'readr',
        'dplyr',
        'tidyr',
        'purrr',
        'tibble'
      ),
      globals = c(
        'mobs_to_long',
        'mobs_dframe_to_long'
      )
    )
  )

future::plan(
  future::sequential
)

names(mobs_list) = mobs_pths %>%
  fs::path_file() %>%
  stringr::str_remove('_mod_obs\\.rds$')

# Remove sites with invalid observation data.

dodgy_sites = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::keep(
    function(x) {

      regular_dodgy = !is.null(x$regular) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$regular) ||
            is.list(x$regular$obs)
        )

      interval_dodgy = !is.null(x$interval) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$interval) ||
            is.list(x$interval$obs)
        )

      regular_dodgy || interval_dodgy
    }
  )

if (length(dodgy_sites) > 0) {

  logger::log_warn(
    glue::glue(
      "Removing {length(dodgy_sites)} site(s) with invalid observation data: ",
      "{paste(names(dodgy_sites), collapse = ', ')}"
    )
  )

  mobs_list = mobs_list[
    !names(mobs_list) %in% names(dodgy_sites)
  ]
}

mobs_site_codes = names(mobs_list)

sites_geo = sites_geo %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    code %in% mobs_site_codes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    code,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Record task timing.

# qaqc_task_timings[['Load test MOBS']] = tibble::tibble(
#   task = 'Load test MOBS',
#   runtime_seconds = as.numeric(
#     difftime(
#       Sys.time(),
#       load_test_mobs_task_start,
#       units = 'secs'
#     )
#   )
# )

# Normalise requested report time-series configuration.

report_tseries_config = if (
  isTRUE(PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES) &&
    !is.null(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES) &&
    length(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES) > 0
) {

  MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES %>%
    purrr::map(
      normalise_mobs_report_tseries_config
    )

} else {

  list()
}

report_site_codes = report_tseries_config %>%
  purrr::map_chr('code')

names(report_tseries_config) = report_site_codes

# Retain only requested sites with available MOBS data.

missing_report_site_codes = setdiff(
  report_site_codes,
  mobs_site_codes
)

if (length(missing_report_site_codes) > 0) {

  logger::log_warn(
    glue::glue(
      "Requested MOBS time-series site(s) not available for reporting: ",
      "{paste(missing_report_site_codes, collapse = ', ')}"
    )
  )
}

report_site_codes = intersect(
  report_site_codes,
  mobs_site_codes
)

report_tseries_config = report_tseries_config[
  report_site_codes
]

```{r load_ref_mobs, include=FALSE, eval = NEED_MOBS}
if (NEED_MOBS && !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR)) {

  # Read Reference site metadata.

  ref_sites_used_pth = find_sites_used_file(
    REF_MOBS_DIR
  )

  if (is.null(ref_sites_used_pth)) {
    stop(
      'Could not find Reference Sites_used.rds or 00Sites_used.rds in: ',
      REF_MOBS_DIR,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  ref_sites_geo = readr::read_rds(
    ref_sites_used_pth
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      code,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  # Load Reference MOBS for sites available in the Test data.

  ref_mobs_pths = fs::dir_ls(
    REF_MOBS_DIR,
    regexp = '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
  )

  if (length(ref_mobs_pths) == 0) {
    stop(
      'No Reference MOBS files found in: ',
      REF_MOBS_DIR,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Load and convert Reference MOBS data.

  ref_mobs_workers = set_parallel_plan(
    workers_requested = worker_cap,
    max_workers = 8,
    prefer_multicore = TRUE
  )

  ref_mobs_list = ref_mobs_pths %>%
    furrr::future_map(
      ~ readr::read_rds(.x) %>%
        mobs_to_long(),
      .options = furrr::furrr_options(
        seed = TRUE,
        scheduling = Inf,
        packages = c(
          'readr',
          'dplyr',
          'tidyr',
          'purrr',
          'tibble'
        ),
        globals = c(
          'mobs_to_long',
          'mobs_dframe_to_long'
        )
      )
    )

  future::plan(
    future::sequential
  )

  names(ref_mobs_list) = ref_mobs_pths %>%
    fs::path_file() %>%
    stringr::str_remove('_mod_obs\\.rds$')

  # Remove sites with invalid observation data.

  ref_dodgy_sites = ref_mobs_list %>%
    purrr::keep(function(x) {

      regular_dodgy = !is.null(x$regular) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$regular) ||
            is.list(x$regular$obs)
        )

      interval_dodgy = !is.null(x$interval) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$interval) ||
            is.list(x$interval$obs)
        )

      regular_dodgy || interval_dodgy
    })

  if (length(ref_dodgy_sites) > 0) {

    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        "Removing {length(ref_dodgy_sites)} Reference site(s) with invalid observation data: ",
        "{paste(names(ref_dodgy_sites), collapse = ', ')}"
      )
    )

    ref_mobs_list = ref_mobs_list[
      !names(ref_mobs_list) %in% names(ref_dodgy_sites)
    ]
  }

  # Retain metadata for successfully loaded Reference sites.

  ref_sites_geo = ref_sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      code %in% names(ref_mobs_list)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      code,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
}

highlight_sites_for_map = if (nrow(sites_geo_map_sub) > 0) {

}

mobs_grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR

if (!is.null(mobs_grouping_var)) {

}

n_site_types = if (!is.null(mobs_grouping_var)) {

# unique choices for autocomplete (code / station / site / name squished)
na2empty = function(x) if (is.null(x)) "" else ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))

code_vec    = if ("code"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$code    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
station_vec = if ("station" %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$station else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
site_vec    = if ("site"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$site    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
name_vec    = if ("name"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$name    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))

sites_geo_search = sites_geo %>%
  mutate(search_key = str_squish(
    paste(na2empty(code_vec), na2empty(station_vec), na2empty(site_vec), na2empty(name_vec))
  ))

search_choices = sites_geo_search %>%
  distinct(search_key) %>%
  filter(nchar(search_key) > 0) %>%
  arrange(search_key) %>%
  pull(search_key)

if (all(c('longitude', 'latitude') %in% names(sites_geo_search))) {
  m = m %>%
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      data = sites_geo_search,
      lng = ~longitude,
      lat = ~latitude,
      opacity = 0,
      fillOpacity = 0,
      radius = 0.1,
      popup = ~search_key,
      group = 'search_layer',
      options = leaflet::pathOptions(
        interactive = FALSE
      )
    )
} else {
  # assume sf geometry is present
  m = m %>%
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      data = sites_geo_search,
      opacity = 0,
      fillOpacity = 0,
      radius = 0.1,
      popup = ~search_key,
      group = 'search_layer',
      options = leaflet::pathOptions(
        interactive = FALSE
      )
    )
}

m = m %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
function(el, x){
  var map = this;

  function flyToMatch(q){
    if(!q) return;
    q = (''+q).toLowerCase().trim();
    var hit = null;

    map.eachLayer(function(lyr){
      if (!hit && lyr && lyr.options && lyr.options.group === 'search_layer' && lyr.getLatLng){
        var txt = '';

        if (lyr.getPopup && lyr.getPopup()){
          txt = ('' + lyr.getPopup().getContent()).toLowerCase();
        } else if (lyr.options.layerId){
          txt = ('' + lyr.options.layerId).toLowerCase();
        }

        if (txt.indexOf(q) !== -1) hit = lyr;
      }
    });

    if (hit){
      var ll = hit.getLatLng();
      map.flyTo(ll, 10);
    }
  }

  function bindBox(){
    var box = document.getElementById('site_search_input');
    if (!box) return;
    box.addEventListener('change', function(){ flyToMatch(this.value); });
    box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Enter'){ flyToMatch(this.value); } });
  }

  setTimeout(bindBox, 0);
}
    "
  )

# datalist options (escape just in case)
dl_opts = lapply(search_choices, function(val) {
  htmltools::tags$option(value = htmltools::htmlEscape(val))
})

# RENDER: map + input together (no print/browsable)
htmltools::tagList(
  m,
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "margin-top: .75rem; max-width: 600px;",
    htmltools::tags$label(`for` = "site_search_input", "Search sites (code / station / site):"),
    htmltools::tags$input(
      id = "site_search_input", type = "text", list = "site_choices",
      placeholder = "Type and press Enter...",
      style = "width: 100%; padding: .4rem .5rem; margin-top: .25rem;"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$datalist(id = "site_choices", dl_opts)
  )
)

```{r plot_mobs_tseries, include=FALSE, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES || SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS}

# Plot daily and hourly MOBS time series per site.
# Data preparation and optional PDF writing are parallelised.
# If the report is pure R, set_parallel_plan() can use multicore on HPC and
# multisession on Windows.

mobs_tseries_prep_task_start = Sys.time()

mobs_tseries_labels = MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS

if (is.na(mobs_tseries_labels['ref_mod'])) {
  mobs_tseries_labels['ref_mod'] = RUN_LABELS[[2]]
}

mobs_tzone = if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
  'local'
} else {
  'UTC'
}

if (!exists('MOBS_TSERIES_VARS')) {
  stop('MOBS_TSERIES_VARS must be defined in the user input file.')
}

if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
  
  if (is.null(TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH) || is.na(TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH) || TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH == '') {
    stop('TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH must be supplied when MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME = TRUE.')
  }
  
  if (!fs::file_exists(TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH)) {
    stop(
      glue::glue(
        'Timezone file not found: {TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH}'
      )
    )
  }
  
  tz_sf = sf::st_read(
    TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH,
    quiet = TRUE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::select(timezone = tzid) %>%
    sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(sites_geo))
  
  nearest_tz_idx = sf::st_nearest_feature(sites_geo, tz_sf)
  
  sites_geo = sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timezone = tz_sf$timezone[nearest_tz_idx]
    )
  
  mobs_site_codes = names(mobs_list)
  
  missing_tzone = sites_geo %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      code %in% mobs_site_codes,
      is.na(timezone)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(code) %>%
    unique()
  
  if (length(missing_tzone) > 0) {
    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        'No timezone assigned to the following sites: {paste(missing_tzone, collapse = ", ")}. ',
        'These sites will be plotted in UTC.'
      )
    )
  }
  
} else if (!'timezone' %in% names(sites_geo)) {
  
  sites_geo = sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timezone = NA_character_
    )
}

sites_meta = if (inherits(sites_geo, 'sf')) {
  sf::st_drop_geometry(sites_geo)
} else {
  sites_geo
}

sites_meta = sites_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::any_of(c('code', 'station', 'site', 'name', 'timezone', MOBS_GROUPING_VAR))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()


mobs_tseries_workers = set_parallel_plan(
  workers_requested = worker_cap,
  max_workers = 4,
  prefer_multicore = TRUE
)

mobs_tseries_opts = furrr::furrr_options(
  seed = TRUE,
  scheduling = Inf,
  packages = c(
    'dplyr', 'tidyr', 'lubridate', 'purrr',
    'tibble', 'openair', 'stringr'
  ),
  globals = c(
    'format_mobs_to_plot',
    'summarise_mobs',
    'calculate_cumsum',
    'resolve_mobs_plot_tzone',
    'resolve_var_id',
    'mobs_tzone',
    'MOBS_THRESHOLD',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_VARS',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT',
    'sites_meta'
  )
)

# keep only variables requested for MOBS time-series plots.
# expanded includes 'subprecip'
MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED = MOBS_TSERIES_VARS %>%
  purrr::map(function(var_nm) {
    
    var_id = resolve_var_id(
      var = var_nm,
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    )
    
    c(
      var_nm,
      var_id,
      get_var_param(
        var = var_id,
        key = 'aliases',
        var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        default = character()
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

mobs_tseries_var_params = MOBS_TSERIES_VARS %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map_chr(function(var_nm) {
    resolve_mobs_var_id(
      var = var_nm,
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    )
  })

mobs_list_for_plot = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        var %in% MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED
      )
  }) %>%
  purrr::compact()

#join ref_mobs_list if it exists
if (
  isTRUE(PLOT_REF_TSERIES) &&
  !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) &&
  exists('ref_mobs_list')
) {

  mobs_list_for_plot = purrr::imap(
    mobs_list_for_plot,
    function(test_df, site_code) {

      if (is.null(test_df) || nrow(test_df) == 0) {
        return(test_df)
      }

      ref_mobs = ref_mobs_list[[site_code]]

      if (is.null(ref_mobs)) {
        return(test_df)
      }

      ref_df = ref_mobs$regular

      if (is.null(ref_df) || nrow(ref_df) == 0) {
        return(test_df)
      }

      ref_df = ref_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          var %in% MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          code,
          date,
          var,
          ref_mod = mod
        )

      test_df %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          ref_df,
          by = c('code', 'date', 'var')
        )
    }
  )
}

if (!isTRUE(SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS)) {
  mobs_list_for_plot = mobs_list_for_plot[
    intersect(
      report_site_codes,
      names(mobs_list_for_plot)
    )
  ]
}

mobs_plotlist = mobs_list_for_plot %>%
  furrr::future_map(
    function(df) {
      
      if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      site_code = df %>%
        dplyr::pull(code) %>%
        unique() %>%
        .[1]
      
      site_tzone = resolve_mobs_plot_tzone(
        site_code = site_code,
        sites_meta = sites_meta,
        mobs_tzone = mobs_tzone,
        timezone_col = 'timezone'
      )
      
    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        date = lubridate::with_tz(date, tzone = site_tzone)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        lubridate::year(date) == min(lubridate::year(date), na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        any(is.finite(mod)),
        date >= min(date[is.finite(mod)], na.rm = TRUE),
        date <= max(date[is.finite(mod)], na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      format_mobs_to_plot(
        data_thresh = MOBS_THRESHOLD,
        drop_na_mod = FALSE, # this is used in summarise_mobs, not for plotting
        avg_time = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME,
        summary_stat = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(sites_meta, by = 'code')
    },
    .options = mobs_tseries_opts
  ) %>%
  purrr::compact()

future::plan(future::sequential)

names(mobs_plotlist) = mobs_plotlist %>%
  purrr::map_chr(~ .x %>%
                   dplyr::pull('code') %>%
                   unique() %>%
                   .[1])
```

```{r save-mobs-tseries-pdfs, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES && SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS}
# Save MOBS time-series plots to PDF.

```{r prepare-mobs-tseries-text-flags, echo = FALSE, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES}
mobs_report_tseries_period = parse_mobs_tseries_period(
  MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD %||% NULL
)

get_report_tseries_vars_for_site = function(
    df,
    cfg,
    period,
    var_params_list,
    var_param_names = NULL,
    var_order = NULL
) {
  
  resolution = cfg$resolution %||% 'summary'
  
  if (resolution == 'raw') {
    
    data_tbl = df %>%
      dplyr::filter(month > 0) %>%
      dplyr::pull(data) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
      filter_mobs_tseries_period(
        period = period
      )
    
  } else {
    
    data_tbl = df %>%
      dplyr::filter(month == -1) %>%
      dplyr::pull(data) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
      filter_mobs_tseries_period(
        period = period
      )
  }
  
  if (nrow(data_tbl) == 0) {
    return(character())
  }
  
  vars_available = unique(data_tbl$var) %>%
    setdiff('subprecip')
  
  vars_available = vars_available[
    purrr::map_lgl(
      vars_available,
      function(var_nm) {
        
        var_param_nm = if (
          !is.null(var_param_names) &&
            var_nm %in% names(var_param_names)
        ) {
          var_param_names[[var_nm]]
        } else {
          var_nm
        }
        
        resolve_var_id(
          var = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = var_params_list
        ) %in% names(var_params_list)
      }
    )
  ]
  
  vars_selected = if (is.null(cfg$vars)) {
    vars_available
  } else {
    intersect(vars_available, cfg$vars)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(var_order)) {
    
    vars_selected = c(
      var_order[
        var_order %in% vars_selected
      ],
      vars_selected[
        !vars_selected %in% var_order
      ]
    )
    
  } else {
    
    vars_selected = vars_selected[
      order(
        get_var_order_index(
          vars_selected,
          var_params_list
        ),
        vars_selected
      )
    ]
  }
  
  vars_selected
}

) %>%

report_tseries_var_ids_shown = purrr::map_chr(

    var_param_nm = if (
      var_nm %in% names(mobs_tseries_var_params)

    }

    resolve_var_id(
      var = var_param_nm,
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    )
  }
)

show_ref_tseries_note = purrr::map2_lgl(
  report_mobs_plotlist_used,
  report_tseries_config_used,
  function(df, cfg) {

    resolution = cfg$resolution %||% 'summary'

    if (resolution == 'raw') {

      data_tbl = df %>%
        dplyr::filter(month > 0) %>%
        dplyr::pull(data) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
        filter_mobs_tseries_period(
          period = mobs_report_tseries_period
        )

    } else {

      data_tbl = df %>%
        dplyr::filter(month == -1) %>%
        dplyr::pull(data) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
        filter_mobs_tseries_period(
          period = mobs_report_tseries_period
        )
    }

    'ref_mod' %in% names(data_tbl) &&
      any(is.finite(data_tbl$ref_mod))
  }
) %>%
  any()

```{r mobs_tseries_user_text, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES)) {

  cat('## Time series plots\n\n')

  tseries_intro_sentences = c(
    'The plots below compare modelled and observed meteorological variables at selected monitoring sites.'
  )

  if (identical(MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_STYLE, 'ribbon')) {
    tseries_intro_sentences = c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      'Observed values are shown as a shaded area and modelled values as a line.'
    )
  } else {
    tseries_intro_sentences = c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      'Observed and modelled values are shown as lines.'
    )
  }

  if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
    tseries_intro_sentences = c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      'Time-series values are plotted using local time.'
    )
  } else {
    tseries_intro_sentences = c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      'Time-series values are plotted in UTC.'
    )
  }

  if (isTRUE(show_ref_tseries_note)) {
    tseries_intro_sentences = c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      'Where available, reference modelled values are also shown.'
    )
  }

  cat(
    '<p>',
    stringr::str_c(
      tseries_intro_sentences,
      collapse = ' '
    ),
    '</p>\n\n',
    sep = ''
  )
}

```{r mobs_report_plot_tseries, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES && exists('sites_geo_map_sub') && nrow(sites_geo_map_sub) != 0, results = 'asis'}

if (length(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES) > 0) {

  # Prepare interactive MOBS time series for the report.
  
  period_label = format_mobs_period_label(
    list(
      period_start = mobs_report_tseries_period$start,
      period_end = mobs_report_tseries_period$end
    )
  )
  
  summary_label = format_mobs_summary_label(
    summary_time = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME,
    summary_stat = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT
  )
  
  
  # Create individual interactive plot ----------------------------------------
  
  make_interactive_plot_block = function(
      data,
      var,
      site_name,
      var_params_list,
      var_param_names = NULL,
      summary_label,
      resolution = 'summary',
      period_label = NULL
  ) {
    
    var_param_nm = if (
      !is.null(var_param_names) &&
        var %in% names(var_param_names)
    ) {
      var_param_names[[var]]
    } else {
      var
    }
    
    plot_height = if (resolution == 'raw') {
      340
    } else {
      280
    }
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = 'mobs-ts-block',
      style = paste(
        'margin-top: 1.0em;',
        'margin-bottom: 1.0em;'
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        style = paste(
          stringr::str_glue(
            'height: {plot_height}px;'
          ),
          'margin: 0;',
          'padding: 0;',
          'overflow: visible;'
        ),
        plot_mobs_tseries_interactive(
          df = data,
          var_nm = var,
          site_name = site_name,
          var_param_nm = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = var_params_list,
          height = plot_height,
          obs_style = MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_STYLE,
          obs_alpha = MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_ALPHA,
          ref_colour = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['colour']],
          ref_linetype = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['linetype']],
          ref_linewidth = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['linewidth']],
          legend_labels = mobs_tseries_labels,
          x_resolution = resolution
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  # Monitoring-site key -------------------------------------------------------
  
  site_name_col = c(
    'site',
    'site_name',
    'name'
  ) %>%
    intersect(
      names(sites_geo)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::first(
      default = NA_character_
    )
  
  site_key = sites_geo %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      code %in% names(report_mobs_plotlist_used)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      site_name = if (!is.na(site_name_col)) {
        as.character(.data[[site_name_col]])
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      site_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      code = factor(
        code,
        levels = names(report_mobs_plotlist_used)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      code = as.character(code)
    )

  
  cat(
    stringr::str_to_sentence(
      paste0(
        summary_label,
       ' data are shown for all selected sites.\n\n'
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  # Site-code key -------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (nrow(site_key) > 0) {
    
    site_key_tbl_data = site_key %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        sites_geo %>%
          sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
          dplyr::select(
            code,
            dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::distinct(),
        by = 'code'
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        site_name,
        dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR),
        code
      )
    
    site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl_data %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::sub_missing(
        columns = dplyr::everything(),
        missing_text = ''
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_label(
        site_name = 'Monitoring site',
        code = 'Code'
      )
    
    if (
      !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
      length(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) == 1 &&
      MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(site_key_tbl_data)
    ) {
      site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl %>%
        gt::cols_label(
          !!rlang::sym(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) :=
            MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL
        )
    }
    
    site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl %>%
      gt::tab_options(
        data_row.padding = gt::px(3),
        table.align = 'left'
      )
    
    print(site_key_tbl)
  }
  
  
  # Site tabs and variable subtabs -------------------------------------------
  
  purrr::walk2(
    report_mobs_plotlist_used,
    report_tseries_config_used,
    function(site_df, site_cfg) {
      
      site_code = unique(
        site_df$code
      )[1]
      
      site_name = site_key %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          code == site_code
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          site_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::first(
          default = NA_character_
        )
      
      site_name_heading = stringr::str_remove_all(
        site_name,
        fixed('.')
      )
      
      site_label = if (
        is.na(site_name_heading) ||
        site_name_heading == '' ||
        site_name_heading == site_code
      ) {
        site_code
      } else {
        paste0(
          site_name_heading,
          ' (',
          site_code,
          ')'
        )
      }
      
      cat(
        '\n\n### ',
        site_label,
        '\n\n',
        sep = ''
      )
      
      
      site_vars = filter_report_site_vars(
        df = site_df,
        cfg = site_cfg,
        period = mobs_report_tseries_period,
        var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        var_param_names = mobs_tseries_var_params,
        var_order = MOBS_TSERIES_VARS
      )
      
      
      if (nrow(site_vars) == 0) {
        
        cat(
          'No time-series variables are available for this site.\n\n'
        )
        
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(site_vars))) {
        
        var_nm = site_vars$var[[i]]
        
        var_param_nm = if (
          var_nm %in% names(mobs_tseries_var_params)
        ) {
          mobs_tseries_var_params[[var_nm]]
        } else {
          var_nm
        }
        
        var_heading = format_var_label(
          var = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          context = 'mobs',
          output = 'html',
          include_units = FALSE
        )
        
        p = make_interactive_plot_block(
          data = site_vars$data[[i]],
          var = var_nm,
          site_name = site_name,
          var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          var_param_names = mobs_tseries_var_params,
          summary_label = summary_label,
          resolution = site_vars$resolution[[i]],
          period_label = period_label
        )
        
        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )
        
        child_env$var_heading = var_heading
        child_env$p = p
        
        
        child_text = c(
          '#### `r var_heading`',
          '',
          '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
          'p',
          '```',
          ''
        )
        
        
        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    }
  )

}
