```{r modStats, include=FALSE, eval=EVALUATE_MOBS}

# Prepare regular MOBS data for evaluation.
# Retain the first calendar year to exclude the additional WRF
# boundary timestamp at the beginning of the following year.

mobs_regular_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    yr = suppressWarnings(
      min(lubridate::year(df$date), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        lubridate::year(date) == yr,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Convert temperatures from degrees Celsius to Kelvin.
        mod = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(mod),
          mod + 273.15,
          mod
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(obs),
          obs + 273.15,
          obs
        ),
        # Mask observations wherever modelled data are missing.
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Calculate accumulated precipitation for each site.

test_mobs_acc_precip = mobs_regular_eval %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(df) {

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    sub = df %>%
      dplyr::filter(var == 'subprecip')

    if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    all_obs_na = all(is.na(sub$obs))

    tibble::tibble(
      code = dplyr::first(sub$code),
      date = max(sub$date, na.rm = TRUE),
      var = 'subprecip',
      mod = if (all_obs_na) NA_real_ else sum(sub$mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      obs = if (all_obs_na) NA_real_ else sum(sub$obs, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })


# Exclude precipitation and wind direction from ordinary modstats.

mobs_regular_eval_stats = mobs_regular_eval %>%
  purrr::map(function(df) {

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !var %in% c('precip', 'subprecip', 'wd')
      )
  })


# Calculate temporal modstats for each site.

test_mobs_regular_site_stats = mobs_regular_eval_stats %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(
    calculate_modstats,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = c('code', 'var'),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var)


# Calculate precipitation modstats separately.

test_mobs_site_precip_stats = test_mobs_acc_precip %>%
  calculate_modstats(
    modstats = c('MB', 'NMB'),
    type = c('code', 'var'),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  )


# Combine regular site-level modstats and precipitation modstats.

test_mobs_regular_site_stats = test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(test_mobs_site_precip_stats)


# Add site metadata.

site_meta_for_stats = sites_geo %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      'code',
      'site',
      'station',
      MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
    ))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    code,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


test_mobs_regular_site_stats = test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = 'Test'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    code,
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      'site',
      'station',
      MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
    )),
    var
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
    missing_label = 'All sites'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    code,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c('site', 'station'))
    ),
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var
  )


# Save site-level modstats by variable.

if (isTRUE(SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS)) {

  test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
    dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
    dplyr::group_split() %>%
    purrr::walk(function(df) {

      this_var = unique(df$var)

      readr::write_csv(
        df,
        fs::path(
          tables_pth_out,
          stringr::str_glue(
            'Mobs_modstats_{this_var}.csv'
          )
        )
      )
    })
}


# Calculate modelled-period means for each site.

test_mobs_regular_site_means = mobs_regular_eval_stats %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(
    summarise_mobs,
    avg_time = 'period',
    summary_stat = 'mean',
    data_thresh = MOBS_THRESHOLD,
    drop_na_mod = TRUE,
    start_date = NULL,
    end_date = NULL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    test_mobs_acc_precip
  )


# Prepare interval MOBS data for evaluation.
# WRF currently uses regular observations only.

mobs_interval_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Calculate duration-weighted modelled-period means for interval data.

test_mobs_interval_site_means = mobs_interval_eval %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(df) {

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        is.finite(mod),
        is.finite(obs),
        is.finite(interval_hours),
        interval_hours > 0
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        code,
        var
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mod = stats::weighted.mean(
          mod,
          w = interval_hours
        ),
        obs = stats::weighted.mean(
          obs,
          w = interval_hours
        ),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  })


# Check that site-variable combinations occur in only one data type.

if (
  nrow(test_mobs_regular_site_means) > 0 &&
  nrow(test_mobs_interval_site_means) > 0
) {

  duplicate_mobs_site_vars = dplyr::inner_join(
    test_mobs_regular_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(code, var),
    test_mobs_interval_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(code, var),
    by = c('code', 'var')
  )

  if (nrow(duplicate_mobs_site_vars) > 0) {

    duplicate_mobs_site_vars_text =
      duplicate_mobs_site_vars %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        site_var = paste0(code, ' (', var, ')')
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(site_var) %>%
      toString()

    stop(
      paste0(
        'The following Test site-variable combinations occur in ',
        'both regular and interval MOBS data: ',
        duplicate_mobs_site_vars_text,
        '. Each site-variable combination must use only one ',
        'observation data type.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}


# Combine regular and interval site means.

test_mobs_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  test_mobs_regular_site_means,
  test_mobs_interval_site_means
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )


# Calculate spatial modstats across sites.

test_mobs_stats = calculate_modstats(
  test_mobs_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
)


if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(test_mobs_site_means)
) {

  test_mobs_stats = calculate_modstats(
    test_mobs_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(c('var', MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      test_mobs_stats
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      get_var_order_index(
        var,
        WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
      ),
      var
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR),
      .after = var
    ) %>%
    format_mobs_group_labels(
      grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
      missing_label = 'All sites'
    )
}


# Save spatial modstats.

if (isTRUE(SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS)) {

  readr::write_csv(
    test_mobs_stats,
    fs::path(
      tables_pth_out,
      MOBS_STATS_FNAME
    )
  )
}


# Prepare spatial modstats for the report table.

test_mobs_stats_table = test_mobs_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = test_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    var,
    dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
    )
  )
```

```{r mobs_report_stats_comp, include=FALSE,   eval=isTRUE(EVALUATE_MOBS) && !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) && isTRUE(testref_period_overlap)}

# Prepare Test and Reference MOBS data for comparison over their
# common modelled period.

# Test regular MOBS data.

testref_test_regular_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        date >= testref_start_date,
        date < testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        mod = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(mod),
          mod + 273.15,
          mod
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(obs),
          obs + 273.15,
          obs
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Reference regular MOBS data.

testref_ref_regular_eval = ref_mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        date >= testref_start_date,
        date < testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        mod = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(mod),
          mod + 273.15,
          mod
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          var %in% c('T2', 'td2') & is.finite(obs),
          obs + 273.15,
          obs
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Test interval MOBS data.

testref_test_interval_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        start_date >= testref_start_date,
        end_date <= testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Reference interval MOBS data.

testref_ref_interval_eval = ref_mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        start_date >= testref_start_date,
        end_date <= testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })

# Combine MOBS lists into data frames with consistent schemas.

testref_test_regular_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_test_regular_eval
)

testref_ref_regular_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_ref_regular_eval
)

testref_test_interval_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_test_interval_eval,
  interval = TRUE
)

testref_ref_interval_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_ref_interval_eval,
  interval = TRUE
)

# Match regular Test and Reference MOBS records so that comparison
# statistics use the same sites, variables and timestamps.

testref_regular_pairs = dplyr::inner_join(
  testref_test_regular_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      date,
      var,
      test_obs = obs,
      test_mod = mod
    ),
  testref_ref_regular_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      date,
      var,
      ref_obs = obs,
      ref_mod = mod
    ),
  by = c(
    'code',
    'date',
    'var'
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(test_obs),
    is.finite(test_mod),
    is.finite(ref_obs),
    is.finite(ref_mod)
  )

# Test and Reference should contain the same observation for each
# matched site-variable-timestamp combination.

testref_obs_mismatch = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      test_obs,
      ref_obs
    )
  )

if (nrow(testref_obs_mismatch) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      'Test and Reference MOBS data contain different observation ',
      'values for ',
      nrow(testref_obs_mismatch),
      ' matched regular record(s).'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Create paired Test and Reference regular evaluation datasets.

testref_test_regular_paired = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    date,
    var,
    obs = test_obs,
    mod = test_mod
  )

testref_ref_regular_paired = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    date,
    var,
    obs = ref_obs,
    mod = ref_mod
  )

# Match interval Test and Reference MOBS records so that comparison
# statistics use the same sites, variables and observation intervals.

testref_interval_pairs = dplyr::inner_join(
  testref_test_interval_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      var,
      test_obs = obs,
      test_mod = mod
    ),
  testref_ref_interval_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      var,
      ref_obs = obs,
      ref_mod = mod
    ),
  by = c(
    'code',
    'start_date',
    'end_date',
    'var'
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(test_obs),
    is.finite(test_mod),
    is.finite(ref_obs),
    is.finite(ref_mod)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    interval_hours = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        end_date,
        start_date,
        units = 'hours'
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(interval_hours),
    interval_hours > 0
  )


# Test and Reference should contain the same observation for each
# matched site-variable-interval combination.

testref_interval_obs_mismatch = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      test_obs,
      ref_obs
    )
  )

if (nrow(testref_interval_obs_mismatch) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      'Test and Reference MOBS data contain different observation ',
      'values for ',
      nrow(testref_interval_obs_mismatch),
      ' matched interval record(s).'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


# Create paired Test and Reference interval evaluation datasets.

testref_test_interval_paired = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    var,
    obs = test_obs,
    mod = test_mod,
    interval_hours
  )

testref_ref_interval_paired = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    var,
    obs = ref_obs,
    mod = ref_mod,
    interval_hours
  )

# Calculate paired temporal modstats for regular MOBS data.

testref_test_regular_site_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_test_regular_paired,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = c('code', 'var'),
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_ref_regular_paired,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = c('code', 'var'),
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )


# Add site metadata and run labels.

testref_test_regular_site_stats = testref_test_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = test_label
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_stats = testref_ref_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = ref_label
  )


# Combine paired temporal site statistics.

testref_mobs_site_stats = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_regular_site_stats,
  testref_ref_regular_site_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    code,
    dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        'site',
        'station',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    var
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
    missing_label = 'All sites'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    code,
    run
  )

# Calculate paired regular site means.

testref_test_regular_site_means =
  testref_test_regular_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = mean(
      obs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mod = mean(
      mod,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_means =
  testref_ref_regular_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = mean(
      obs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mod = mean(
      mod,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Calculate paired duration-weighted interval site means.

testref_test_interval_site_means =
  testref_test_interval_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = stats::weighted.mean(
      obs,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    mod = stats::weighted.mean(
      mod,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

testref_ref_interval_site_means =
  testref_ref_interval_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = stats::weighted.mean(
      obs,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    mod = stats::weighted.mean(
      mod,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Check that paired site-variable combinations occur in only one
# MOBS data type.

if (
  nrow(testref_test_regular_site_means) > 0 &&
  nrow(testref_test_interval_site_means) > 0
) {

  duplicate_testref_site_vars = dplyr::inner_join(
    testref_test_regular_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    testref_test_interval_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    by = c(
      'code',
      'var'
    )
  )

  if (nrow(duplicate_testref_site_vars) > 0) {

    duplicate_testref_site_vars_text =
      duplicate_testref_site_vars %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        site_var = paste0(
          code,
          ' (',
          var,
          ')'
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(site_var) %>%
      toString()

    stop(
      paste0(
        'The following paired Test/Reference site-variable ',
        'combinations occur in both regular and interval MOBS data: ',
        duplicate_testref_site_vars_text,
        '. Each site-variable combination must use only one ',
        'observation data type.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Combine regular and interval paired site means.

testref_test_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_regular_site_means,
  testref_test_interval_site_means
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

testref_ref_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_ref_regular_site_means,
  testref_ref_interval_site_means
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

# Calculate spatial modstats over the paired Test/Reference data.

testref_test_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_test_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
)  %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

testref_ref_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_ref_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(testref_test_site_means)
) {

  testref_test_stats = calculate_modstats(
    testref_test_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(
      c(
        'var',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      testref_test_stats
    )
  
  testref_ref_stats = calculate_modstats(
    testref_ref_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(
      c(
        'var',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      testref_ref_stats
    )
}

# Combine Test and Reference spatial modstats for reporting.

testref_mobs_stats_table = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      run = test_label
    ),
  testref_ref_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      run = ref_label
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    var,
    dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
    ),
    run
  )

```{r mobs_modstats_helper_flags}

mobs_temporal_modstats_available = FALSE
mobs_spatial_modstats_available = FALSE
mobs_modstats_available = FALSE

testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available = FALSE
testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available = FALSE
testref_mobs_modstats_available = FALSE

if (isTRUE(EVALUATE_MOBS)) {

  mobs_temporal_modstats_available =
    exists('test_mobs_regular_site_stats') &&
    !is.null(test_mobs_regular_site_stats) &&
    nrow(test_mobs_regular_site_stats) > 0

  mobs_spatial_modstats_available =
    exists('test_mobs_stats_table') &&
    !is.null(test_mobs_stats_table) &&
    nrow(test_mobs_stats_table) > 0

  mobs_modstats_available =
    mobs_temporal_modstats_available ||
    mobs_spatial_modstats_available

  testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available =
    !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) &&
    isTRUE(testref_period_overlap) &&
    exists('testref_mobs_site_stats') &&
    !is.null(testref_mobs_site_stats) &&
    nrow(testref_mobs_site_stats) > 0

  testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available =
    !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) &&
    isTRUE(testref_period_overlap) &&
    exists('testref_mobs_stats_table') &&
    !is.null(testref_mobs_stats_table) &&
    nrow(testref_mobs_stats_table) > 0

  testref_mobs_modstats_available =
    testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available ||
    testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available
}

```{r mobs_modstats_user_text, eval=mobs_modstats_available && PRINT_MODSTATS_TABLES, results='asis'}

cat('## Model evaluation statistics\n\n')

modstats_stats_for_text = MODSTATS_STATS %>%
  setdiff('n')

modstats_stat_labels = c(
  MB = 'mean bias (MB)',
  NMB = 'normalised mean bias (NMB)',
  RMSE = 'root mean square error (RMSE)',
  FAC2 = 'fraction of modelled-observed pairs within a factor of two (FAC2)',
  r_pearson = 'Pearson correlation coefficient (r)',
  r_spearman = 'Spearman rank correlation coefficient (&rho;)'
)

modstats_stats_text = MODSTATS_STATS %>%
  setdiff('n') %>%
  modstats_stat_labels[.] %>%
  unname() %>%
  format_elements_to_print()

modstats_intro_sentences = c(
  'The modelled variables have been evaluated against observations using commonly used model evaluation statistics.',
  glue::glue(
    'The statistics reported in the plots and tables are {modstats_stats_text}.'
  )
)

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Two complementary types of evaluation are shown.',
    'Site-level temporal statistics are calculated separately for each monitoring site and variable using the paired modelled and observed time series.',
    'Modelled-period mean spatial statistics are calculated after averaging each site over the modelled period, and therefore describe how well the model reproduces spatial differences across the monitoring network.',
    glue::glue(
      'For regular observations, only site-variable pairs with data capture >= {MOBS_THRESHOLD}% are included in the modelled-period mean spatial evaluation.'
    ),
    'The temporal site-level statistics are calculated from the available paired regular time series at each site.'
  )

} else {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Modelled-period mean spatial statistics are shown below.',
    'These statistics are calculated after averaging each site over the modelled period, and therefore describe how well the model reproduces spatial differences across the monitoring network.',
    glue::glue(
      'For regular observations, only site-variable pairs with data capture &ge; {MOBS_THRESHOLD}% are included in the modelled-period mean spatial evaluation.'
    ),
    'Site-level temporal statistics are also calculated separately for each monitoring site and variable using the paired modelled and observed time series, and are available in the accompanying CSV output.'
  )
}

if ('subprecip' %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS) {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Precipitation is evaluated separately using accumulated totals over the modelled period, with MB and NMB reported for each site.'
  )
}

if ('wd' %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS) {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Wind direction is excluded from the model evaluation statistics.'
  )
}

if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Where a site grouping variable is available, the spatial evaluation statistics are also shown by site group.'
  )
}

modstats_units_sentences = c(
  'MB and RMSE have the same units as the meteorological variable, while NMB is expressed as a percentage.',
  'FAC2 and the correlation coefficients are dimensionless.'
)

cat(
  '<p>',
  stringr::str_c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    collapse = ' '
  ),
  '</p>\n\n',
  '<p>',
  stringr::str_c(
    modstats_units_sentences,
    collapse = ' '
  ),
  '</p>\n\n',
  sep = ''
)
```

```{r print_mobs_testref_temporal_modstats, eval=testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available && REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' && PRINT_MODSTATS_TABLES, results = 'asis'}
make_modstats_dt(

```{r plot_interactive_scatter_render, eval = PLOT_MOBS_SCATTER_PLOTS, results = 'asis'}

purrr::iwalk(
  scatter_plots_interactive,
  function(p, var_nm) {
    
    var_heading = format_var_label(
      mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
      context = 'mobs',
      output = 'html',
      include_units = FALSE
    )
    
    plot_block = htmltools::tags$div(
      class = 'mobs-scatter-block',
      style = paste(
        'position: relative;',
        'padding-bottom: 2.2em;'
      ),
      
      p %>%
        plotly::layout(
          hovermode = FALSE
        ),
      
      htmltools::tags$button(
        type = 'button',
        class = 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary',
        style = paste(
          'position: absolute;',
          'right: 0;',
          'bottom: 0;',
          'padding: 2px 8px;',
          'font-size: 0.85em;'
        ),
        'Hover: off',
        onclick = '
          const block = this.closest(".mobs-scatter-block");
          const plot = block.querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
          
          if (!plot) {
            return;
          }
          
          const hoverOff = plot.layout.hovermode === false;
          
          Plotly.relayout(
            plot,
            {
              hovermode: hoverOff
                ? "closest"
                : false
            }
          );
          
          this.textContent = hoverOff
            ? "Hover: on"
            : "Hover: off";
        '
      )
    )
    
    child_text = c(
      paste0('#### ', var_heading),
      '',
      '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
      'plot_block',
      '```',
      ''
    )
    
    child_env = new.env(
      parent = parent.frame()
    )
    
    child_env$plot_block = plot_block
    
    cat(
      knitr::knit_child(
        text = child_text,
        envir = child_env,
        quiet = TRUE
      ),
      sep = '\n'
    )
  }
)

```{r mobs_testref_scatter, eval=PLOT_MOBS_SCATTER_PLOTS && !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) && testref_period_overlap}

# Join the Test and Reference modelled-period site means.
testref_scatter_base = testref_test_site_means %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    test_mod = mod,
    obs_test = obs
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    testref_ref_site_means %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        ref_mod = mod,
        obs_ref = obs
      ),
    by = c(
      'code',
      'var'
    )
  )

# The Test and Reference calculations should be based on exactly the
# same observations.
obs_mismatch = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      obs_test,
      obs_ref
    )
  )

if (nrow(obs_mismatch) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      'Observed modelled-period means differ between the Test and ',
      'Reference MOBS datasets for one or more site-variable pairs.'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

testref_scatter_base = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    var,
    obs = obs_test,
    ref_mod,
    test_mod
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

# Split by variable in the user-defined observation-variable order.
testref_scatter_grouped = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var)

testref_scatter_group_keys = testref_scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_keys() %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

testref_scatter_plots_interactive = testref_scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  purrr::set_names(testref_scatter_group_keys) %>%
  {
    plot_order = get_var_order_index(
      unname(mobs_var_params[names(.)]),
      WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    )

    .[
      order(
        is.na(plot_order),
        plot_order,
        names(.)
      )
    ]
  }

testref_scatter_plots_interactive =
  testref_scatter_plots_interactive %>%
  purrr::imap(function(df, var_nm) {

    plot_mobs_testref_scatter_interactive(
      mobs_data = df,
      var_name = var_nm,
      var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
      var_param_nm = mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
      point_colour = MOBS_SCATTER_POINT_COLOUR,
      group_col = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
      group_label = if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      colours = if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_COLOURS
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      test_label = test_label,
      ref_label = ref_label,
      height = 360
    )
  }) %>%
  purrr::compact()

```{r prepare-mobs-stats-map-data, eval = PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS && isTRUE(mobs_temporal_modstats_available), include = FALSE}

sites_meta = if (inherits(sites_geo, 'sf')) {
  sf::st_drop_geometry(sites_geo)
} else {
  sites_geo
}

test_mobs_site_stats2 = test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sites_meta %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::any_of(
          c(
            'code',
            'station',
            'site',
            'name',
            'elev(m)',
            'latitude',
            'longitude',
            'call'
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = 'code'
  )

mobs_map_stats = intersect(
  MOBS_MAP_STATS,
  names(test_mobs_site_stats2)
)

mobs_map_vars = test_mobs_site_stats2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

mobs_map_combinations = tidyr::expand_grid(
  var = mobs_map_vars,
  stat = mobs_map_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    purrr::map2_lgl(
      var,
      stat,
      ~ mobs_map_stat_is_enabled(
        var_nm = .x,
        stat = .y,
        include_by_var = MOBS_MAP_STATS_INCLUDE_BY_VAR,
        exclude_by_var = MOBS_MAP_STATS_EXCLUDE_BY_VAR
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    purrr::map2_lgl(
      var,
      stat,
      function(var_nm, stat_nm) {
        
        x = test_mobs_site_stats2 %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            var == var_nm
          ) %>%
          dplyr::pull(
            dplyr::all_of(stat_nm)
          )
        
        any(
          is.finite(x)
        )
      }
    )
  )

vars_avail = mobs_map_combinations %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

stats_avail = mobs_map_combinations %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    stat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(stat)

mobs_map_var_labs = vars_avail %>%
  purrr::map_chr(
    function(var_nm) {

      format_var_label(
        mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
        var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        context = 'mobs',
        output = 'html',
        include_units = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

mobs_map_stat_labs = c(
  MB = 'MB',
  NMB = 'NMB',
  RMSE = 'RMSE',
  r_pearson = 'r',
  r_spearman = 'r'
)

mobs_map_stat_palettes = list(
  MB = MOBS_MAP_MB_PALETTE,
  NMB = MOBS_MAP_NMB_PALETTE,
  RMSE = MOBS_MAP_RMSE_PALETTE,
  r_pearson = MOBS_MAP_R_PALETTE,
  r_spearman = MOBS_MAP_R_PALETTE
)

mobs_stat_maps = stats_avail %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(
    function(stat_nm) {

      vars_for_stat = mobs_map_combinations %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          stat == stat_nm
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(var)

      vars_for_stat %>%
        purrr::set_names() %>%
        purrr::map(
          function(var_nm) {

            plot_mobs_stat_map(
              sites_df = test_mobs_site_stats2,
              stat = stat_nm,
              var_nm = var_nm,
              var_param_nm = mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
              var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
              stat_lookup = mobs_map_stat_labs,
              palette = mobs_map_stat_palettes[[stat_nm]]
            )
          }
        )
    }
  )

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  mobs_map_selector = htmltools::tags$select(
    id = 'mobs-map-var-selector',
    class = 'form-select',
    style = 'width: auto; max-width: 300px;',
    purrr::map2(
      vars_avail,
      mobs_map_var_labs,
      function(var_nm, var_lab) {

        htmltools::tags$option(
          value = var_nm,
          htmltools::HTML(var_lab)
        )
      }
    )
  )

  mobs_map_selector_ui = htmltools::tags$div(
    class = 'mobs-map-selector',
    htmltools::tags$label(
      `for` = 'mobs-map-var-selector',
      'Variable:'
    ),
    mobs_map_selector
  )

  default_mobs_map_var = vars_avail[1]

  mobs_map_tabs = stats_avail %>%
    purrr::set_names() %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(stat_nm) {

        vars_for_stat = names(
          mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]]
        )

        purrr::map(
          vars_for_stat,
          function(var_nm) {

            make_mobs_map_container(
              map = mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]][[var_nm]],
              stat = stat_nm,
              var_nm = var_nm
            )
          }
        )
      }
    )

  mobs_map_css = htmltools::tags$style(
    htmltools::HTML(
      '
      .mobs-map-stack {
        position: relative;
      }

      .mobs-map-panel {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .mobs-map-panel.mobs-map-active {
        position: relative;
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      '
    )
  )

  mobs_map_selector_js = htmltools::tags$script(
    htmltools::HTML(
      '
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {

        const selector = document.getElementById("mobs-map-var-selector");

        if (!selector) return;

        function updateMobsMaps() {

          const selectedVar = selector.value;

          document.querySelectorAll(".mobs-map-panel").forEach(function(panel) {
            panel.classList.remove("mobs-map-active");
          });

          const varClass = "mobs-map-var-" +
            selectedVar.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "-");

          document.querySelectorAll("." + varClass).forEach(function(panel) {
            panel.classList.add("mobs-map-active");
          });
        }

        selector.addEventListener(
          "change",
          updateMobsMaps
        );

        setTimeout(
          updateMobsMaps,
          500
        );
      });
      '
    )
  )
}
```

```{r mobs_stats_maps, eval = PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS, fig.width = 8.4, results = 'asis'}
if (
  length(vars_avail) > 0 &&
  length(stats_avail) > 0
) {

  n_requested_maps = nrow(
    mobs_map_combinations
  )

  if (n_requested_maps > 20) {
    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        'Requested {n_requested_maps} MOBS statistic maps. ',
        'The HTML report may become large or slow to load.'
      )
    )
  }

  if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

    # Shared map styling and pollutant selector.

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_css
      ),
      '\n'
    )

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_selector_ui
      ),
      '\n\n'
    )

    # Statistic maps as tabs. The H5 heading is required by the
    # R Markdown tabset mechanism but is below the report TOC depth.

    cat('##### Statistics {.tabset}\n\n')

    purrr::walk(
      stats_avail,
      function(stat_nm) {

        stat_heading = unname(
          mobs_map_stat_labs[stat_nm]
        )

        if (
          length(stat_heading) == 0 ||
          is.na(stat_heading)
        ) {
          stat_heading = stat_nm
        }

        maps_this_stat = mobs_map_tabs[[stat_nm]]

        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )

        child_env$maps_this_stat = maps_this_stat
        child_env$stat_heading = stat_heading

        child_text = c(
          '###### `r stat_heading` {.unlisted}',
          '',
          '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
          'htmltools::browsable(',
          '  htmltools::tags$div(',
          '    class = "mobs-map-stack",',
          '    maps_this_stat',
          '  )',
          ')',
          '```',
          ''
        )

        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    )

    # Shared pollutant switching behaviour.

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_selector_js
      ),
      '\n'
    )

  } else {

    # Static report: show each pollutant and statistic sequentially.

    purrr::walk(
      vars_avail,
      function(var_nm) {

        var_heading = format_var_label(
          mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
          var_params_list = WRF_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          context = 'mobs',
          output = 'html',
          include_units = FALSE
        )

        child_text = c(
          paste0(
            '### ',
            var_heading
          ),
          ''
        )

        purrr::walk(
          stats_avail,
          function(stat_nm) {

            if (!var_nm %in% names(mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]])) {
              return(NULL)
            }

            stat_heading = unname(
              mobs_map_stat_labs[stat_nm]
            )

            if (
              length(stat_heading) == 0 ||
              is.na(stat_heading)
            ) {
              stat_heading = stat_nm
            }

            map_nm = paste0(
              'map_',
              stat_nm
            )

            child_text <<- c(
              child_text,
              paste0(
                '#### ',
                stat_heading
              ),
              '',
              '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
              map_nm,
              '```',
              ''
            )
          }
        )

        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )

        purrr::walk(
          stats_avail,
          function(stat_nm) {

            if (var_nm %in% names(mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]])) {

              map_nm = paste0(
                'map_',
                stat_nm
              )

              child_env[[map_nm]] =
                mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]][[var_nm]]
            }
          }
        )

        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    )
  }
}
